Norwegian Folk Legends: place-coordinate audit

All 383 recorded place names checked against Kartverket SSR, with SSB historical county and municipality classifications covering 1838–1954. Retrieved 2026-10-11T15:16:58.030908+00:00.

This is a review report, not an approved replacement coordinate list. An exact name match can still be the wrong geographic feature. Historical counties, former municipalities, broad regions, qualifiers and uncertain names require context. Distances compare two representative points and do not prove an error. Original names and coordinates remain unchanged.

  • multiple exact locations review: 208
  • one exact location review: 71
  • variant or fuzzy review: 102
  • no location specified: 2
